name: FTP / FTPS
statusNote: Tested with disposable FTP and explicit FTPS servers. Hosting-specific compatibility may vary; requires MLSD and overwrite-by-rename support.
description: Deploy prebuilt files to FTP and certificate-verified FTPS servers with tracked cleanup and retryable deployment journals.
install:
composer config repositories.shipper-ftp git https://github.com/shippercli/provider-ftp.git
composer require 'shippercli/cli:^1.0.10' 'shippercli/provider-ftp:^1.0'
